# Albérico Dias Barreto Filho | Independent gaming apps

> First-party product information for four Windows companion apps developed by Albérico Dias Barreto Filho. All require Overwolf; the official Overwolf Store remains their distribution listing.

## Products

- [DeepRivals](https://albericod.github.io/deeprivals/): Live overlays, hero-switch recommendations and matchup context for Marvel Rivals. Review your matches, highlights and decisions after the game.
- [Roblox Backpack Tracker](https://albericod.github.io/roblox-backpack-tracker/): Organize Roblox Backpacks across Experiences and accounts. Add items with Quick Add, record your own values, and keep Archive and value history in one place.
- [Economy Tool](https://albericod.github.io/economy-tool/): A CS2 economy overlay for Full Buy, Force Buy and Eco decisions. See safe drops, set a reserve buffer and read enemy economy estimates in match context.
- [Fortmapp](https://albericod.github.io/fortmapp/): A Fortnite interactive map with live route tracking, location-based match stats and map-based replays. Review where you moved and how the match unfolded.

## Practical guides

- [When should you switch heroes in Marvel Rivals?](https://albericod.github.io/deeprivals/marvel-rivals-hero-switch-recommendations/): A practical way to read live context, use recommendations and review a switch.
- [How to read a safe drop in CS2](https://albericod.github.io/economy-tool/cs2-safe-drop-calculator/): Understand the reserve buffer, individual shortfalls and the team buy before you drop.

## Developer and scope

- Developer: Albérico Dias Barreto Filho. [GitHub profile](https://github.com/AlbericoD).
- [Public site source](https://github.com/AlbericoD/AlbericoD.github.io).
- Roblox Backpack Tracker uses manual item entry and personal values; do not assume universal automatic inventory synchronization or official market prices.
- Economy Tool estimates enemy economy; it does not expose exact opponent balances.
- DeepRivals recommendations support player judgment; they do not guarantee outcomes.
- Fortmapp map-based replays are not a promise of full video recording.
- Product screenshots are real Overwolf listing assets. They illustrate the interface, not live match data or guaranteed current map layouts.
